title: Cannot open Compatibility-mode projects with discrete graphics card when using Nouveau
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3-stable_linux.x86_64, 4.2.2-stable_linux.x86_64, 4.1.4-stable_linux.x86_64

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Fedora Linux 41 (Workstation Edition) - Wayland - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NV194 - AMD Ryzen 9 9900X 12-Core Processor (24 Threads)

### Issue description

Opening or creating any project in Compatibility rendering mode instantly crashes the editor.

```
$ godot -e .
Godot Engine v4.3.stable.official.77dcf97d8 - https://godotengine.org
WARNING: XOpenIM failed
     at: DisplayServerX11 (platform/linuxbsd/x11/display_server_x11.cpp:6103)
Found discrete GPU, setting DRI_PRIME=1 to use it.
Note: Set DRI_PRIME=0 in the environment to disable Godot from using the discrete GPU.
WARNING: XCreateIC couldn't create wd.xic
     at: _create_window (platform/linuxbsd/x11/display_server_x11.cpp:5708)
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 24.3.3 - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon Graphics (radeonsi, raphael_mendocino, LLVM 19.1.5, DRM 3.59, 6.12.10-200.fc41.x86_64)
```

Per the suggestion on a similar ticket (#83269), I attempted to apply `--rendering-driver opengl3`, but that had no effect.

The suggestion in the error output (setting `DRI_PRIME=0` in the environment) is a viable temporary workaround but results in Godot not using the discrete GPU.

### Steps to reproduce

Example `project.godot`

```
; Engine configuration file.
; It's best edited using the editor UI and not directly,
; since the parameters that go here are not all obvious.
;
; Format:
;   [section] ; section goes between []
;   param=value ; assign values to parameters

config_version=5

[application]

config/name="new-game-project"
config/features=PackedStringArray("4.3", "GL Compatibility")
config/icon="res://icon.svg"

[rendering]

renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"
renderer/rendering_method.mobile="gl_compatibility"
```

Simply open an empty project in the editor. The editor will crash

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18630479/new-game-project.zip)

Attached is an empty Godot project created in Godot 4.3 using the Compatibility Rendering mode.
